name: Jiangsu Yinhe Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Yinhe Electronics Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells computer, communication, and other electronic equipment in China and internationally. The company offers solar storage system for commercial buildings, industrial parks, mines, and islands applications; and precision structural parts, such as power battery box for electric vehicle, solar power inverter, and high/low voltage power transmission and distribution equipment.
